info.name: PromptEdit - Pixelforge webhooks
info.description:
Exercises the webhook endpoint and the polling fallback.

Setup:
1. Set {{app_url}} (http://localhost, or your tunnel URL).
2. Set {{webhook_secret}} to PIXELFORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET from .env - requests are signed with it.
3. Set {{pixelforge_api_key}} for the folder 0 requests that hit the real API.

Every webhook request is signed automatically by a collection-level pre-request script, so the app's signature check is exercised for real rather than bypassed.

variable.description: Your app. Use the tunnel URL when testing real deliveries.
Your Pixelforge key. Do not commit a real one.

item.name: 6. Fallback: no webhook at all
item.description:
The case this collection exists for. If a webhook is never delivered, the scheduled reconciler must still settle the generation by polling.

How to test:
1. Run 0 > Create a generation (it uses [slow]).
2. Do NOT fire any webhook from folder 1.
3. Wait past your reconcile interval, or run the command below in a terminal.
4. The generation must reach succeeded with the correct actual cost, from polling alone.

    ./vendor/bin/sail artisan generations:reconcile

Then confirm with 'Get the generation (real API)' that your stored usage and cost match Pixelforge's.

item.name: Get the generation (real API) - compare after reconciling

request.description: Compare status, usage and the derived cost with what the reconciler stored.
